"""design_800E 모델링 준비: 코호트, 결과, 특성, 분할만 만든다. 학습/성능 계산 없음.
설계서에서 모호하거나 문제가 있는 부분은 아래 ASSUMPTION 주석의 보수적 해석을 따른다."""
import json, pathlib
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import GroupShuffleSplit

WS = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA, OUT = WS / "data", pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
design = json.loads((WS / "design_800E.json").read_text())

P = pd.read_csv(DATA / "patients.csv.gz")
A = pd.read_csv(DATA / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
D = pd.read_csv(DATA / "diagnoses.csv.gz")
L = pd.read_csv(DATA / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
O = pd.read_csv(DATA / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])

A = A.sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"]).reset_index(drop=True)
A["tp"] = A["discharge_time"]  # tp.anchor = discharge, offset 0h

# outcome: 같은 환자의 다음 입원 admit_time 이 (tp, tp+30d] 안에 있으면 1
A["next_admit"] = A.groupby("patient_id")["admit_time"].shift(-1)
gap = A["next_admit"] - A["tp"]
A["readmit_30d"] = ((gap > pd.Timedelta(0)) & (gap <= pd.Timedelta(days=30))).astype(int)

# cohort
A = A.merge(P, on="patient_id", how="left")
coh = A[(A["age"] >= 18) & (A["discharge_status"] != "died")].copy()

# features
coh["n_prior_adm"] = coh.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()  # admit_time 이 현재보다 앞선 입원 수
# ASSUMPTION: length_of_stay_h 열이 없어 (discharge_time - admit_time) 시간으로 계산
coh["los_h"] = (coh["discharge_time"] - coh["admit_time"]).dt.total_seconds() / 3600

def windowed(df, tcol, mask):
    m = df[mask].merge(coh[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]], on="admission_id")
    return m[(m[tcol] >= m["admit_time"]) & (m[tcol] <= m["tp"])]

dial = windowed(O, "order_time", O["order_type"] == "dialysis_order")
coh["dialysis_ordered"] = coh["admission_id"].isin(dial["admission_id"]).astype(int)
cr = windowed(L, "report_time", L["test"] == "creatinine").sort_values("report_time")
coh["cr_last"] = coh["admission_id"].map(cr.groupby("admission_id")["value"].last())
hb = windowed(L, "report_time", L["test"] == "hemoglobin")
coh["hgb_min"] = coh["admission_id"].map(hb.groupby("admission_id")["value"].min())

# ASSUMPTION: 진단 특성은 현재 입원(admission_id)으로만 한정. 설계서는 범위가 없어 환자 전체
# (미래 입원 포함)로 집계될 수 있음 -> 누수. 확인 필요.
D["chf"] = D["icd_code"].str.startswith("I50")
D["ckd"] = D["icd_code"].str.startswith("N18")
g = D.groupby("admission_id").agg(n_dx=("seq", "size"), dx_chf=("chf", "any"), dx_ckd=("ckd", "any"))
coh = coh.merge(g, left_on="admission_id", right_index=True, how="left")
coh[["n_dx"]] = coh[["n_dx"]].fillna(0)
coh[["dx_chf", "dx_ckd"]] = coh[["dx_chf", "dx_ckd"]].fillna(False).astype(int)

# split: ASSUMPTION family_id 결측(약 80%) 환자는 patient_id 를 그룹으로 사용
coh["split_group"] = coh["family_id"].fillna(coh["patient_id"])
sp = design["split"]
gss = GroupShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=sp["test_fraction"], random_state=sp["seed"])
tr_idx, te_idx = next(gss.split(coh, groups=coh["split_group"]))
coh["split"] = "train"
coh.iloc[te_idx, coh.columns.get_loc("split")] = "test"

feats = [f["name"] for f in design["features"]]
cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "tp", "split"] + feats + ["readmit_30d"]
coh[cols].to_csv(OUT / "cohort_features.csv", index=False)

# 점검
for k in ["patient_id", "split_group"]:
    s = coh.groupby(k)["split"].nunique()
    print(f"{k} 가 train/test 양쪽에 걸친 그룹 수:", int((s > 1).sum()))
print("cohort rows", len(coh), "| outcome rate", round(coh["readmit_30d"].mean(), 4))
print(coh.groupby("split")["readmit_30d"].agg(["size", "mean"]))
print("missing rate:\n", coh[feats].isna().mean().round(3)[lambda s: s > 0])
EOF
cd /srv/leakruns/335043fb4748-t1/ws/prep_800E && python3 prepare.py
